title: Jaguars trade a 2027 first and a 2029 second to the Eagles for Jordan Davis
dek: ESPN's Adam Schefter broke a deal that sends a defensive tackle the Eagles signed to a big extension in March to a Jacksonville team buying defense.
what: On 9 November 2026 ESPN's Adam Schefter reported, citing sources, that the Jacksonville Jaguars are sending a 2027 first-round pick and a 2029 second-round pick to the Philadelphia Eagles for defensive tackle Jordan Davis.
Yahoo Sports and NBC Sports report the trade as done. Yahoo says it was Jacksonville's third trade for a defensive player that day, after safety Jessie Bates and tackle Davon Godchaux.

Yahoo reports the Eagles signed Davis to a three-year, $78 million extension in March 2026, and that the Eagles were 2-7 after seven straight losses. Schefter says the Eagles now have 10 picks in the first two rounds of the next three drafts.
I did not find a statement from either team in the sources I opened.
why: A first-round pick for a lineman is a large price, and the deal came on the same day as two other Jaguars defensive trades.
